# Anne Shirley & Phil Gordon

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) — served as her bridesmaid · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Lady P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Park P0](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0000), +16 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) go to register at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and feel overwhelmed and insignificant. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Old St. John's Cemetery, where she and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) meet [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), who eagerly strikes up a conversation and introduces herself.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P5](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0005), [v3 ch.Lady P21](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0021), [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)_

> [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) chats lightly with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) about her suitors, her hesitations about [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), and her fear of marriage before they explore an old graveyard together. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) pauses at the grave of an eighteen-year-old midshipman and leaves a small cluster of pansies on it. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) reflect on Philippa's charming, innocent nature compared to [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048), [v3 ch.Lady P62](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0062), [v3 ch.Lady P67](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0067), [v3 ch.Lady P71](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0071)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as their freshman class wins the annual Arts Rush under [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's leadership. [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) quickly adopts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), introducing them into Redmond's active social circle. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a bundle of letters from home—including updates from [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), Ruby, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md)—which helps connect her old life in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to her new life in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport).
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), Philippa, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Charlie go for a walk in the park together and admire the autumn foliage and harbour views. On their return route along [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#spofford-avenue), [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) shows them a charming, old-fashioned little house called Patty's Place. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels an instant connection to the house and has a presentiment that she will become better acquainted with it.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VI In the Park

_Sources: [v3 ch.Park P14](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0014), [v3 ch.Park P24](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0024), [v3 ch.Park P32](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0032), [v3 ch.Park P40](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0040)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) visit Patty's Place and successfully arrange to rent the house from Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) Spofford and Miss [Maria](../character/maria.md) Spofford for the upcoming school year. Later, [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) visits them and excitedly asks to join their housekeeping arrangement, agreeing to their conditions regarding chores, plain living, and set caller hours.
>
> — v3 · Chapter X Patty’s Place

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P0](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0000), [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and her cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md). Before leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) faces mixed reviews about her published story and adopts a stray cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), whom they fail to chloroform. Eventually, [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives to chaperon the household with a relaxed attitude toward their independence.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)_

> [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) settles into Patty's Place with her two cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md). [The Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) quickly establishes dominance over [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), while [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) engage in repeated battles before eventually becoming close friends. The household chats comfortably about house duties and Aunt Jamesina's humorous views on cats and life.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058), [v3 ch.Relationships P62](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0062), [v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065)_

> [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) arrives with butter and chats with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about rising prices and simple living. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then reads aloud an entertaining letter from [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), which recounts humorously misspelled updates about his school, household misadventures, and curious questions.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVII A Letter from Davy

_Sources: [v3 ch.Davy P0](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0000), [v3 ch.Davy P5](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0005), [v3 ch.Davy P6](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0006), [v3 ch.Davy P21](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0021)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) chat in the living room on Anne's twentieth birthday. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) comes downstairs in her party dress to admire herself in the mirror and join the conversation about her various suitors and future prospects before leaving for a dance. Afterwards, [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) briefly discuss Phil's quirky disposition.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIX An Interlude

_Sources: [v3 ch.Interlude P0](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0000), [v3 ch.Interlude P7](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0007), [v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024), [v3 ch.Interlude P36](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0036)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) chat inside Patty's Place before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) steps outside into the orchard. There, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) joins her and confesses his love, asking her to marry him. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejects his proposal, leaving [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) heartbroken and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upset over the loss of their friendship.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XX Gilbert Speaks

_Sources: [v3 ch.Speaks P0](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0000), [v3 ch.Speaks P15](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0015), [v3 ch.Speaks P31](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0031), [v3 ch.Speaks P36](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0036)_

> During her stay in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) with [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits her humble birthplace and meets the woman currently living there. The woman allows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to explore the house, including the room where she was born, and hands over a small packet of old letters written by Anne's parents. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later visits her parents' grave and reads the letters, feeling for the first time that she truly knows them.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P11](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P15](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0015), [v3 ch.Yesterday P22](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0022)_

> [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) writes a letter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point) describing her summer stay at a boardinghouse. She recounts meeting a homely divinity student named [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), whose impressive sermon leaves her deeply moved and questioning her own frivolous nature. In a postscript, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) admits to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she fears she has fallen in love with him.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIV Enter Jonas

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Jonas P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 ch.Jonas P23](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0023)_

> While dressing for a reception at Patty's Place, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has been seen frequently with [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), which secretly disquiets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) arrives to escort [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to the event, where she spots [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Christine across the room and compares herself to her.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVI Enter Christine

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Christine P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Christine P20](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0020)_

> At Patty's Place, the girls prepare for exams and learn from Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) that they can rent the house for another year. Later, while out walking, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) reveals to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she has accepted Jonas's marriage proposal. As they discuss love and marriage, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on her feelings for [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVII Mutual Confidences

_Sources: [v3 ch.Confidences P1](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0001), [v3 ch.Confidences P7](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0007), [v3 ch.Confidences P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 ch.Confidences P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)_

> The girls return to Patty's Place for their final year at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), sharing stories and laughs with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) about their vacations and suitors. Later, while studying during a rainy evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) reminisce over old [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) manuscripts, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to read a sketch she wrote years before and make a sudden decision.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXV The Last Redmond Year Opens

_Sources: [v3 ch.Opens P0](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0000), [v3 ch.Opens P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 ch.Opens P44](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0044), [v3 ch.Opens P46](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0046)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that a publisher accepted her sketch, bringing excitement to Patty's Place. While on a walk, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) announces his mother and sisters will visit, unnerving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Roy's family arrives a day early on Friday, creating chaos, but the awkward visit ends with Roy's sister [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) bonding with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P31](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0031)_

> As the girls pack to leave Patty's Place after graduation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for a walk with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) proposes to her in romantic fashion, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) suddenly realizes she does not love him and refuses his proposal. She returns home shaken and confesses the rejection to [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), who eventually forgives and comforts her.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVIII False Dawn

_Sources: [v3 ch.Dawn P12](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0012), [v3 ch.Dawn P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 ch.Dawn P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v3 ch.Dawn P35](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0035)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling disillusioned after her breakup with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md). She hears updates about local news and engagements from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and Mrs. [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), serves as bridesmaid for Phil's wedding, and visits [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to meet her newborn baby boy.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings

_Sources: [v3 ch.Weddings P0](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0000), [v3 ch.Weddings P13](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0013), [v3 ch.Weddings P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 ch.Weddings P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as she gives birth to a newborn girl named Joyce, but the baby tragically passes away later that evening. Friends and family offer comfort and prepare the baby for burial, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) grieves deeply and struggles to find meaning or comfort in her sorrow.
>
